notes.title: Automaton Heart Kickstarter is here!
notes.content:
Automaton Heart's long-awaited Kickstarter fundraising campaign is underway!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lukevincent/automaton-heart]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lukevincent/automaton-heart[/url]

Hitting the stretch goals or going beyond in general will expand the scope of the game accordingly. Check the Kickstarter description to see what I mean in particular.

Thanks for being here and for playing the Automaton Heart demo. I've been adding to it frequently and feel its becoming a very unique and interesting experience.

-Luke
